datasheet_identity.title: ES5AC THRU ES5JC SMC Surface Mount Fast Recovery Rectifier (DO-214AB)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet ES5AC THRU ES5JC; ES5DC column: VRRM = 200 V, VRMS = 140 V, VDC = 200 V (p. 1 maximum ratings).
Absolute maximum ratings for operating-region use only (never fitted): IF(AV) = 5.0 A, IFSM = 150 A at 8.3 ms half-sine, Tj = -55 to +150 degC (p. 1).
Full manufacturer name on the datasheet: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).

Fig.3 contains three curves (ES5AC-ES5DC solid, ES5EC-ES5GC long-dash, ES5JC short-dash per the in-figure legend); the solid ES5AC-ES5DC vector path was digitized for ES5DC. Axes calibrated against tick labels; x linear 0.2-2.0 V, y log 0.01-20 A.
VF limit 1.0 V applies to the ES5AC-ES5DC group; ES5EC-ES5GC is 1.3 V and ES5JC 1.7 V. Trr limit 35 ns applies to the whole family.
The digitized typical curve shows unusually low forward voltage at low current (0.31 V at 10 mA); this is transcribed as plotted in the source figure without correction.
High-temperature reverse leakage row IR2 = 200 uA at VR = VDC, TA = 125 degC (p. 2) transcribed here as a note only; per archetype it must not be fitted.

Fig.1 (derating), Fig.2 (surge vs cycles) and Fig.4 (reverse current vs percent of rated peak reverse voltage) are present but not digitized: thermal/surge ratings or percent-normalized family curves, not per-part electrical model inputs.
No measured breakdown row exists; breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
source_kind 'typical' on specified test currents means 'exact specified test condition'; the schema enum has no dedicated value for test conditions.
All values converted to SI base units (uA -> A, pF -> F, ns -> s).
